routes.name: Multiple Entry eVisa
routes.summary: Visa-required nationals apply online for a multiple entry eVisa. Having one does not guarantee entry. Crews of aircraft and ships don't need a visa.

other: Official visa-exempt list not found on the pages read, check with the Immigration Division

steps: Get the approved eVisa by email

routes.name: Student Permit

other: Acceptance letter from a designated learning institution
